mentions.name: Edit Square
mentions.description: Edit Square is an online motion graphics editor that runs entirely in the browser, built with WebGPU and WebCodecs. The project began years ago as web forms driving After Effects templates on a Windows server and has evolved into a full motion graphics editor; private invites are currently being sent out.
mentions.source_excerpt: Working hard to finally ship my co-founded product - Edit Square, an online motion graphics editor https://editsquare.com/ - private invites are going out this week, wish me luck!
